resolved.evidence: The p-script troubleshoot now reads 「`/hooks` に出ないときは、例題の②と同じく、JSONの余計なカンマなどを直し、Claude Codeを再起動します。手で試して `Permission denied` と出たら、`chmod +x` を実行します。」 It says the same as the ex-register troubleshoot and keeps the missing-from-list failure apart from the permission failure.

scores.evidence: There are three can-do objectives with Bloom levels. Each one has at least 3 questions with objectiveId (o1: q0, q1, q2, q5; o2: q3, q6, q7; o3: q4, q9, q8), and the exam has apply and evaluate transfer items: q5 on `config/production.yml` and q8 on a Web-page-summarizing MCP server.

hook-problem sets out a concrete failure in 2 sentences (「CLAUDE.mdに「`.env` は編集しないこと」と書いたのに、Claudeが `.env` を書き換えようとしました。」) and adds a version line. hook-predict is ungraded, and option d (Manual) is a real near-miss. The q0 explanation now names 「第2回の拒否ルールのように」 as another mechanism.

The prerequisites list lessons 2, 6 and 7, jq and JSON editing, and s2-setup starts with `jq --version`. Earlier lessons are recalled in s1-lead (「第6回のとおり」「第2回の権限ルールやフック」) and s5-lead (「第7回のスキルやサブエージェントは」). The definitions blocks match the glossary word for word. One gap: `onFailure` appears in s3-pitfall without a gloss.

measure.mjs prints 「prose 1892 (budget 1,200–2,400) · read 2878 · practice reading 1093 · questions 10 · practice sections 1 · est 17.5 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 17)」. Unrounded, the estimate is 17.49, so estMinutes 17 still matches. s1-config now takes the pipe apart in two sentences (「`jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'` が…取り出します。`xargs npx prettier --write` が、そのパスをPrettierに渡します」), which lowers the load. Lint shows 0 warnings. The unchanged load issues remain: two tasks in the practice section, a q9 stem of about 190 characters, and 「許可ではない」 said twice in s3.

The s2 worked example is still complete and now more precise. ex-test says 「下の③の最初の4行は1つのコマンドで」, which matches the reformatted s2-test (4 lines up to `.claude/hooks/block-rm.sh`, then `echo $?`). Its expect names what to swap (「`rm notes.txt` を `ls` に変えると `0` です」). The practice fades it with the same JSON layout (p-predict: 「`"command": "rm notes.txt"` は、`"file_path": ".env"` にします」).

There are inline checks in s1, s2, s3, s5 and the practice. q1 is an apply item, q2 an analyze item (`cd docs && rm notes.txt` against `rmdir old`), and q9 an evaluate item with crossed A×B options. Every wrong option has feedback. One soft spot: q3's answer b (「「hook error」の通知が出て編集が進む」) repeats the s3-table cell almost word for word.

All 6 misconceptions in the brief are corrected with a reason. CLAUDE.md as a guarantee: q0 a/b, q1 a, q7 b. exit 1 blocks: q3 a/c, q5 b. exit 0 approves: s3-zero 「止めないだけで、許可ではありません」 and q3 d. PostToolUse undoes the edit: q6 b. The condition catches everything: q2 a/b/d and the practice-prompt note. Official means safe: q4 d, q8 b. Each feedback is 2 sentences or fewer, and q8 d now names the origin and the author.

s1-lifecycle is a 6-node process diagram with Japanese labels that match the text. The edge 「通す（権限の確認へ）」 agrees with s3-table. The caption states the takeaway, and the alt text describes both paths. All tables have 2 columns, and there are no decorative images.

The task is authentic and faded, and each step has an observable expect. The hints build up from step hint to troubleshoot to model answer, and the troubleshoot is now correct (「…JSONの余計なカンマなどを直し、Claude Codeを再起動します。手で試して `Permission denied` と出たら、`chmod +x` を実行します。」). The p-predict hint can now be applied without guessing (「`"Bash"` を `"Edit"` に変えます」), and practice-checklist gives 5 success criteria. practice-model-script still produces the message the practice-prompt expect quotes (「Blocked: …/.env matches protected pattern '.env'」).

summary-points (4 points) comes after the exam. summary-next has a reflection question (「あなたのCLAUDE.mdで、本当は毎回必ず守らせたいルールはどれでしょう？」), the next lesson and a descriptive link. There are 7 flashcards, and card-before-install now lists the same six labels as s5-checks.

The changed code is still correct. s4-add `claude mcp add --transport http \ notion https://mcp.notion.com/mcp` matches the documented form 「`claude mcp add --transport http <name> <url>`」 (facts-cc-08-hooks-mcp.md). Dropping `// empty` in s2-script and practice-model-script changes nothing for the `Bash` and `Edit|Write` matchers, because those keys are always present. Following the p-predict hint, a `.env` path gives exit 2 and `README.md` gives exit 0, as the expect says. All earlier audit findings stay fixed.

The lesson uses です・ます throughout, the tone is warm (「結果を先に予想しましょう」) and there are no banned phrases. Terms stay consistent: the six s5-checks labels are reused in practice-b-model, practice-b-model-b and card-before-install, and 「権限の確認」 is used everywhere. The ja-editor owns the wording.

The only locale (jp) is complete, the diagram labels are in Japanese, the alt text covers both paths, and the link text is descriptive (「フックの公式ガイド（日本語）」). Plain-text fields (checklist labels, captions, prompt) carry no markdown, for example 「cat .envで」 and 「.envの末尾に」.

niceToHave: s4-add (changed): the comment now reads `# claude mcp add <名前> -- <コマンド>`, but the s4 prose says 「`--` の後に起動コマンドを書きます」. If the code width allows, set it to "# claude mcp add <名前> -- <起動コマンド>" so the two use the same term.
s3-check q3 (unchanged): option b repeats the s3-table phrase 「hook error」, so a learner can pick it by that phrase alone. Set option b md to "フックでは止まらず、ふだんの権限の確認へ進む".

s4 (unchanged): no objective or question covers scopes, yet summary-points[2] and card-scopes are about them. Either tie scopes to o3 with a q8 distractor about committing to `.mcp.json` at `project` scope before trying the server at `local` scope, or cut summary point 3 to "MCPサーバーも、入れる前に確かめてからスコープを選んで追加します。".
s3-zero (unchanged): it repeats the table cell 「（許可ではない）」. Make the s3-table cell "進む。表示はなく、ふだんの権限の確認へ".
s3-pitfall (unchanged): gloss `onFailure` on first use: "…`onFailure`（失敗したときの扱いを決める設定）を `\"block\"` にしたフックなどでは、失敗でも止まります。"
check-quiz q8 (unchanged): add to the explanation "`.mcp.json` に書かれる起動コマンドやURLも、入れる前に読みます。" so q8 also names what runs, which q4 taught as the first check.

practice-b-quiz q9 (unchanged): the stem is about 190 characters, over the 160-character paragraph budget. Move the two candidate descriptions into practice-b-task and keep the stem as "架空の2候補について、いちばん適切な判断はどれでしょう？".
summary: Verification round: review-scope.mjs exited 0 (7 of 49 blocks changed, 8%). The one open must-fix is resolved: the p-script troubleshoot now matches ex-register (restart for a missing hook, `chmod +x` for `Permission denied`). I reviewed all 7 changed blocks in full and found no new errors. ex-test's 「最初の4行」 matches the reformatted s2-test, the p-predict hint applies the earlier suggestion, and the scripts still produce the outputs the lesson expects. validate and lint --strict are clean. measure.mjs shows est 17.5 (17.49 unrounded), which matches estMinutes 17. Every criterion is 3 or higher, and the mean is 3.77.
